## Ready next (first 15 todo leaves whose milestone deps are done)

- `4.4.1` `Analyzer` = char filters → tokenizer → token filters; builder + registry by name+version (M4)
- `4.4.2` Built-ins: `standard`, `keyword`, `whitespace`, `en`, `es`, `pt`; SPEC §6.3 lists each one's full chain, its length guard and its folding preserved set (e.g. whether `es` keeps `ñ`, found in the PR #17 review), and whether `en` maps `’` to `'` before stemming (the English stemmer knows only U+0027, found in 4.3) (M4)
- `4.4.3` Analyzer identity/versioning recorded in schema (SPEC §6.3); the schema remembers whether a definition named a version, so evolution binds an unversioned `analyzer` to the current field's version (SPEC §6.2.4) (M4)
- `4.4.4` Zero-allocation fast path (reuse buffers via `TokenStream`) (M4)
- `4.4.5` Benchmark: tokens/sec per analyzer; fuzz: arbitrary UTF-8 never panics (M4)
- `4.4.6` Unicode version bumps (found in the 4.1 review): moving `persia_analysis::UNICODE_VERSION` (unicode-segmentation or toolchain update) bumps the version of every built-in analyzer whose output changes, with a test listing which ones (SPEC §6.3.1) (M4)
- `4.4.7` Char-filter offset mapping (found in the PR #15 review): a char filter that changes the text records an offset map, and the analyzer maps token spans back to the original field value (SPEC §6.3.1); property: spans stay on char boundaries of the original value, strictly increasing (M4)
- `4.4.8` Query-time analysis for fields whose analyzer stacks tokens (found in the 4.2 review): with `edge_ngram`, queries and synonym terms (SPEC §6.3.2) are analyzed without it, or `SynonymMap::find` never matches stacked prefixes; define the query-time analyzer in SPEC §6.3 (M4)
- `4.4.9` Folding fast path (found in the 4.2 review): `FoldingFilter` allocates for every non-ASCII token even when nothing folds; pre-scan for foldable characters, measured by the 4.4.5 benchmark (M4)
- `4.4.10` Built-in `fr`, `de`, `it` analyzers (found in the PR #17 review): SPEC §6.3 lists them but 4.2.4, 4.3 and 4.4.2 plan only `en`, `es`, `pt`; add their stopword lists and stemmers, or scope them out of §6.3 (M4)
- `9.1.0` ADR: blob upload staging and expected-id API (SPEC §18.8); update SPEC §9.3/§9.4/§9.6 (M9)
- `9.1.1` Content hasher per ADR-0002 producing `BlobId` (type from 1.10.1), chunking parameters (M9)
- `9.1.2` Streaming chunker (`Read` → chunks with CRC and running content hash) (M9)
- `9.1.3` Blob manifest (chunk list) encode/decode (M9)
- `9.2.1` Pack header/superblock + `BlobChunk`/`BlobIndex` frames (SPEC §9.3) (M9)
- … and 15 more
